name: secure-firewall-assistant
description: Configure enrolled lab devices through FMC REST and arbitrary authorized SSH commands.

interface.longDescription: Uses your private local inventory and a local YAML credential file for lab devices. Discovers supported FMC operations from the supplied OpenAPI reference, verifies saved configuration, and provides unrestricted command execution over enrolled SSH accounts for FMCs, FTDs, switches, routers, endpoints, and traffic generators. Deployment requires an explicit request.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the configuration on my selected FMC and report the evidence.
